_comment: Decision 0406. The same file is in sprigr-app-kit packages/app-sdk/tests/fixtures; both validators must give these verdicts. Change both together.

cases.name: a store app may fill five slots
not an object
cases.expect: setup must be an object like { "slots": ["accounting"], "connect": { "tool": "..." } }

cases.name: unknown key
cases.expect: setup has unknown key "logo"; allowed: slots, built_in, connect, sample, starter_questions, starter_routines, starter_builds

cases.name: no slots
cases.expect: setup.slots must be a non-empty array of slots: email, calendar, files, accounting, job-management, store, inventory, marketing, support, shipping, tasks

cases.name: unknown slot
cases.expect: setup.slots has unknown slot "crm"; allowed: email, calendar, files, accounting, job-management, store, inventory, marketing, support, shipping, tasks

cases.name: slot twice
cases.expect: setup.slots lists "email" twice

cases.name: sample not boolean
cases.expect: setup.sample must be true or false

cases.name: built_in with a connect
cases.expect: setup.connect must be absent when setup.built_in is true: a built-in app has no connect step

cases.name: no connect
cases.expect: setup.connect is required unless setup.built_in is true: { "tool": "<tool name>", "inputs"?: [...] } or { "page": "/<path>" }

cases.name: both shapes
cases.expect: setup.connect must declare exactly one of "tool" or "page"

cases.name: neither shape
cases.expect: setup.connect must declare exactly one of "tool" or "page"

cases.name: page escapes
cases.expect: setup.connect.page must be a path on the app's own page starting "/" (letters, digits, - . _ ~ /), got "/../admin"

cases.name: page is a url
cases.expect: setup.connect.page must be a path on the app's own page starting "/" (letters, digits, - . _ ~ /), got "https://evil.example"

cases.name: undeclared tool
cases.expect: setup.connect.tool "other_connect" is not a tool this manifest declares

cases.name: input not in schema
cases.expect: setup.connect.inputs[0].name "region" is not a property of acme_connect's input_schema

cases.name: secret input
cases.expect: setup.connect.inputs[0].name "api_token" looks like a secret; a key or password is typed on the app's own page (use setup.connect.page)

cases.name: empty inputs
cases.expect: setup.connect.inputs must be an array of 1 to 3 inputs when present

cases.name: four questions
cases.expect: setup.starter_questions must be an array of at most 3

cases.name: question on an undeclared slot
cases.expect: setup.starter_questions[0].slot must be one of the slots this app declares in setup.slots, got "files"

cases.name: question too long
cases.expect: setup.starter_questions[0].text is 201 characters; max 200

cases.name: bad cron
cases.expect: setup.starter_routines[0].cron must be a valid 5-field cron expression, got "every day"

cases.name: routine name twice
cases.expect: setup.starter_routines[1].name "daily" is declared twice

cases.name: routine name pattern
cases.expect: setup.starter_routines[0].name must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,31}$, got "Daily Run"

cases.name: build on an undeclared slot
cases.expect: setup.starter_builds.dashboard.slot must be one of the slots this app declares in setup.slots, got "store"

cases.name: unknown build kind
cases.expect: setup.starter_builds has unknown key "report"; allowed: dashboard, workflow

cases.name: built_in not boolean
cases.expect: setup.built_in must be true or false

cases.name: page connect with an unknown key
cases.expect: setup.connect has unknown key "inputs"; allowed: page

cases.name: tool connect with an unknown key
cases.expect: setup.connect has unknown key "label"; allowed: tool, inputs

cases.name: page over 200 characters
cases.expect: setup.connect.page must be a path on the app's own page starting "/" (letters, digits, - . _ ~ /), got "/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"

cases.name: page starting //
cases.expect: setup.connect.page must be a path on the app's own page starting "/" (letters, digits, - . _ ~ /), got "//evil.example"

cases.name: four inputs
cases.expect: setup.connect.inputs must be an array of 1 to 3 inputs when present

cases.name: input not an object
cases.expect: setup.connect.inputs[0] must be an object { "name", "label", "placeholder"? }

cases.name: input with an unknown key
cases.expect: setup.connect.inputs[0] has unknown key "type"; allowed: name, label, placeholder

cases.name: input name twice
cases.expect: setup.connect.inputs[1].name "site" is declared twice

cases.name: input label empty
cases.expect: setup.connect.inputs[0].label must be a non-empty string

cases.name: input placeholder too long
cases.expect: setup.connect.inputs[0].placeholder is 201 characters; max 200

cases.name: inherited name constructor
cases.expect: setup.connect.inputs[0].name "constructor" is not a property of acme_connect's input_schema

cases.name: inherited name toString
cases.expect: setup.connect.inputs[0].name "toString" is not a property of acme_connect's input_schema

cases.name: words that contain pass are not secrets
secret input pin
cases.expect: setup.connect.inputs[0].name "pin" looks like a secret; a key or password is typed on the app's own page (use setup.connect.page)

cases.name: secret input pwd
cases.expect: setup.connect.inputs[0].name "pwd" looks like a secret; a key or password is typed on the app's own page (use setup.connect.page)

cases.name: secret input auth
cases.expect: setup.connect.inputs[0].name "auth" looks like a secret; a key or password is typed on the app's own page (use setup.connect.page)

cases.name: secret input access_key
cases.expect: setup.connect.inputs[0].name "access_key" looks like a secret; a key or password is typed on the app's own page (use setup.connect.page)

cases.name: starter entry not an object
cases.expect: setup.starter_questions[0] must be an object

cases.name: starter entry with an unknown key
cases.expect: setup.starter_questions[0] has unknown key "emoji"; allowed: slot, text

cases.name: four routines
cases.expect: setup.starter_routines must be an array of at most 3

cases.name: routine on an undeclared slot
cases.expect: setup.starter_routines[0].slot must be one of the slots this app declares in setup.slots, got "files"

cases.name: routine title empty
cases.expect: setup.starter_routines[0].title must be a non-empty string

cases.name: routine description empty
cases.expect: setup.starter_routines[0].description must be a non-empty string

cases.name: routine prompt over 2000
cases.expect: setup.starter_routines[0].prompt is 2001 characters; max 2000

cases.name: routine every minute
cases.expect: setup.starter_routines[0].cron runs more than once an hour; a starter routine runs at most hourly, got "* * * * *"

cases.name: routine every 15 minutes
cases.expect: setup.starter_routines[0].cron runs more than once an hour; a starter routine runs at most hourly, got "*/15 * * * *"

cases.name: starter_builds not an object
cases.expect: setup.starter_builds must be an object { "dashboard"?, "workflow"? }

cases.name: build not an object
cases.expect: setup.starter_builds.dashboard must be an object { "slot", "text" }

cases.name: build with an unknown key
cases.expect: setup.starter_builds.dashboard has unknown key "icon"; allowed: slot, text

cases.name: build text empty
cases.expect: setup.starter_builds.workflow.text must be a non-empty string

cases.name: an agent template cannot declare setup
cases.expect: setup cannot be declared by an agent template (kind "agent"): it describes an app's connect step

cases.name: an agent template without setup passes
routine cron 0,30 * * * *
cases.expect: setup.starter_routines[0].cron runs more than once an hour; a starter routine runs at most hourly, got "0,30 * * * *"

cases.name: routine cron 0-59 * * * *
cases.expect: setup.starter_routines[0].cron runs more than once an hour; a starter routine runs at most hourly, got "0-59 * * * *"
